notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.notes:
Thanks for your support and for reporting the issues you've faced. We are monitoring the forum and working on improving the game's performance.

Here is a list of tweaks introduced in the current patch:

- Replaced software cursor with hardware cursor
- Custom game font now works properly without the need to install it
- Videos will now play on scenario endings
- Centered launcher buttons
- Game timer issues should be mitigated

Please let us know if this helps.

Best regards,
SNEG Team
